en: Sepia-toned historic postcard-style photograph of a large early‑20th‑century institutional building behind an iron fence and brick gateposts. The architecture is monumental with tall vertical windows, a tower-like corner block, arched windows on a side wing, and a small domed turret to the left. Leafless trees line the street in the foreground. A signboard stands near the entrance gate.
